carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible along the lateral aspect of the peduncle, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and deep shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the upper lobe of the caudal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A sparse arrangement of high-luminance circular blobs (spots) is visible on the lateral peduncle and near the insertion point of the lower caudal lobe.
